The competition began on 27 July 2009, and concluded on 15 May 2010. The defending champions from the [[2008–09 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|previous season]] are [[Espérance de Tunis]]. ==Team movements== ===Teams relegated to [[2008–09 Tunisian Ligue
